benchmark_suites.cohort_scope: Napkins, towels, hotel/workwear items with repeatable shape, size and material classes; fixed input presentation, folding recipe, assigned bin/stack positions and table-ready pickup requirement.

Shirts, trousers, jeans, blouses, knitwear and mixed piles/baskets across sizes, colours, fabrics, textures, inside-out and varied initial states in unseen home environments; correct fold, destination and ready-to-store placement.

external_comparators.scope_note: DYNA's August 2026 company report says Dyna-2 folds about 95 napkins/hour, 93% meet its table-ready quality bar, and about 1,590 table-ready napkins are produced in an 18-hour shift. Company-reported result, not independently audited by Luminous.

DYNA's August 2026 report retrospectively says Dyna-1 produced about 35 napkins/hour and 480 table-ready napkins per 18-hour shift, with 75% meeting its quality bar; historical company-reported baseline.
Epoch AI reports a DYNA commercial Monster Laundry deployment folding 200,000+ towels across 10 clients in three months at 99% quality acceptance; not a matched household-clothing test.
Sunday Robotics vendor preview reports 99.1% zero-shot folding success over 785 attempts and nine garment types in unseen homes, with zero per-home adaptation; not independently replicated.
Epoch AI cites a Physical Intelligence demonstration reporting 95% folding success for T-shirts and shorts; cohort size and human-relative speed are not supplied in the review.
Epoch AI cites a Physical Intelligence demonstration reporting 75% folding success for jeans; a harder garment subgroup, not a pooled household rate.

metrics.scope: Garments meeting declared endpoint moisture and appearance on first pass.
Energy after declared moisture endpoint, including needless continued drying and finishing.
metrics.target_hypothesis: >=20% lower than matched conventional endpoint control.

metrics.scope: Garment appearance score with frozen ISO 15487 edition and rating procedure.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Non-inferior to matched control; explore one-grade improvement in selected classes.

metrics.scope: Robot completes declared fold geometry, passes the quality bar and places the item in the correct assigned destination without human intervention.
metrics.target_hypothesis: >=0.98 first-pass commercial textile quality acceptance and >=0.995 correct destination placement; >=0.995 household garment success; stretch >=0.995 commercial and >=0.999 household.

metrics.scope: Median end-to-end time including pick, singulation, manipulation, fold, place and recovery.
metrics.target_hypothesis: <=2x skilled-human median on identical garment set.

metrics.scope: 95th percentile accepted garment time including timeouts and recoveries.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Report and improve without hiding timeouts or difficult garments.

metrics.scope: Human interventions for grasp, untangling, correction, reset, safety and placement.
Lost, torn, stretched, snagged, stained or otherwise damaged garment/components.
metrics.target_hypothesis: 0 observed in frozen challenge set with statistical confidence reported.

metrics.scope: Accepted table-ready garments per operating hour after quality inspection and correct destination placement, including rework, jams, human support and stack correction.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Commercial first target >=100 accepted table-ready items/hour and stretch >=120; household separately compared to human P50.

metrics.scope: Accepted garments per elapsed operating hour including rework, jams and human support.
metrics.target_hypothesis: Improve only after quality and intervention gates pass.

metrics.scope: Items that pass first-pass quality and are placed into the correct instructed bin/stack, organized for downstream pickup; fold-only outputs do not count.
metrics.target_hypothesis: First target >=1800 accepted table-ready items per 18-hour commercial shift; stretch >=2160.

metrics.scope: Correct placement into assigned stack, bin, hanger or storage destination, including stack organization and orientation.
metrics.target_hypothesis: >=0.995 commercial linens and >=0.995 household support envelope; stretch >=0.999.

metrics.scope: Time available for accepted production excluding only declared planned maintenance; all jams, recovery, changeovers and unplanned stops included.
